title: Chapter 79: Encountering Bandits Again
content:
Chapter 79: Encountering Bandits Again

The red medicine that replenishes health costs only 1 gold coin a bottle here, and Wang Shuo also bought 10,000 bottles.

There were other items, such as feathers, cotton, and various crop seeds. Wang Shuo also purchased many.

The rest is food.

Wang Shuo also bought rice and flour for 5,000 gold coins and filled everyone's backpacks before stopping.

Now the growth cycle of farmland has become longer. If the village is surrounded and the access to the outside world is cut off, and if there is not enough food, then Barbie Q will be there.

After the purchase was completed, Wang Shuo was eager to return home. He was afraid that if he went back too late, he would hear the bad news from the system that "your Wana Village has been destroyed."

The cavalry team galloped along the grassland at high speed.

Not long after, I saw a large group of people in the distance.

Wang Shuo immediately reined in his horse and took out his telescope to check the situation.

After seeing it clearly, Wang Shuo couldn't help but smile bitterly.

What a fate!

There was another group of horse bandits in front of them, and what was even more incredible was that the person they surrounded was Dongfang Ling.

"This girl is quite unlucky!"

When Wang Shuo was hesitating whether to rescue him, the other party actually separated half of his men and rushed over.

"Oh, I didn't cause trouble for you, but you came here to cause trouble for me!" Anger rose in Wang Shuo's heart.

"Prepare for battle!"

The cavalry squad, led by Ayub, began to charge.

[Cavalry Charge: Increase the movement speed of your own troops by 30% and increase defense by 10% for 30 minutes. 】

Ayub activated his skill.

The Cavalry Squad Medal provides a 20% speed bonus, and coupled with Ayub's skill acceleration, the speed is directly increased by half.

Within a few breaths, the two groups of people collided.

Because the horse bandits on the opposite side did not have anyone with strong combat power, they could serve as arrows for the charge.

Facing Ayub, such a fierce general was immediately dispersed from the formation.

More than a dozen horse bandits were knocked off their horses in this round of attacks.

Wang Shuo was very happy when he saw that his troops were invincible.

This is simply giving away experience and horses.

What makes Wang Shuo even more happy is that its equestrian level has been upgraded with continuous use.

Level 2 equestrian skills make him more comfortable fighting on horseback.

Turning the horse's head, Wang Shuo planned to charge again.

The third leader of the horse bandits not far away frowned when he saw this situation.

"A bunch of trash."

He cursed, turned the horse's head, and the long ax in his hand slashed through the air with a sound of breaking through the air.

[Ma Bandit (ID: Bandit 20014 Doliku), junior general, third master of Pegasus Village]

[Level: Level 22]

[Attack power: 270]

[Defense: 80]

[Health value: 3000]

[Skills: Three-axe, copper wall and iron wall]

Wang Shuo detected the information about this tall and strong man.

He was actually a military commander, Wang Shuo showed a solemn expression.

Doliku's attack power is as high as 270 points. This is the opponent with the highest attack power that Wang Shuo has encountered so far.

At the same time, he also noticed that the health value of humanoid monsters was lower than that of beast monsters.

The Crocodile Lizard I encountered before was only at level 15 and already had 6,000 health points, while this Doriku was at level 22 and only had 3,000 health points.

However, the combat prowess of beasts and humanoid creatures cannot be compared at all.

Facing junior generals, Wang Shuo was still a little frightened.

Suddenly, he thought that he seemed to have 17 purple spirit flowers, each of which could increase his agility by 5 points.

Although each person can only take it once, which is a bit regretful.

Taking it at this time can enhance your own strength, which is naturally excellent.

He quickly took out the purple spirit flowers and gave one to each person.

"Take it quickly."

Wang Shuo was the first to eat it. It tasted a little sweet. The system prompt sounded. His agility value reached 23 points, and his movement speed and attack speed were both increased.

very good!

"The generals of the horse bandits are rushing over, ready to fight!" Wang Shuo immediately shouted to his men.
